einzeiler: Why the Raiders' roster adjustments and organizational alignment point to a brighter…
kurzfassung: The podcast examines the Raiders' recent roster moves, including new tryouts and practice squad additions ahead of the season. It highlights the importance of organizational alignment from ownership down to the coaching staff. Listeners share their predictions and hopes for the upcoming season, anticipating competitive and meaningful games.
stichpunkte: The Raiders conducted a busy round of workouts, bringing in numerous players for evaluation.
Ronnie Bell, Evan Neal, and Aziz Ojulari were signed to the practice squad.
Kirk Cousins is named the starting quarterback, with rookie Fernando Mendoza developing behind him.
Organizational alignment across management and coaching is cited as a key reason for optimism.
Callers and texters weigh in with season predictions, generally targeting around seven wins.
Fans emphasize the importance of playing meaningful games late into December.
